messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "stool"
set: ["stool", "appearance of potassium chloride tablet in stool", "part of this shell may appear in your stool", "clay-colored stools", "abnormal stools", "blood in stools", "black, bloody, or tarry stools", "bloody or tarry stools", "black tarry stools", "bloody or black stools", "diarrhea", "diarrhea or loose stools", "seek emergency medical attention for black or bloody stools", "diarrhea (2%)", "diarrhea or constipation", "fecal impaction"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
